o1:
Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity and sequence-specific DNA binding activity; contributes to RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity.  
Is involved in egg-laying behavior; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction; and multiple aspects of vulval development, including vulval fate specification and morphogenesis.  
Is located in nucleus.  
Is part of RNA polymerase II transcription repressor complex.  
Is expressed in body wall musculature; non-striated muscle; reproductive system; and vulval precursor cell.  
Is part of Ras protein signal transduction and the RAS/MAPK pathway.  
Orthologous to several human genes including ELK1 (ETS transcription factor ELK1).
